what is

INDIE BOOKFEST?

This is the weekend where small presses and self-published authors get the spotlight. Meet your next favorite writer in person, pick up books you won't find at the big chain stores, and hang out with people who get way too excited about a good read.

​

Everyone's welcome here, whether you read one book a year or one a day.

OUR MISSION

Indie BookFest exists to put independent authors, bookish small businesses, and the readers who love discovering something new in the same room. We make space for bold stories, strange ideas, beautiful books, handmade goods, and the kind of connections that do not happen through an algorithm.
